content_units: Streaming Bundle Fit at a Glance
Here’s the best match for each household based on priorities in order: content fit, ad tolerance, screen needs, then budget.
-   Household A:     StreamBox Plus   — best ad-free pick under budget, even though CineNest has better classic-film depth.
-   Household B:     FamilyFlix   — best overall family fit thanks to 4 screens and strong kids focus.
-   Household C:     SportSphere   — best single-service match for documentaries plus weekly football.
Household-by-Household Comparison
Household   Best Option   Monthly Cost   Why It Fits Best   Main Tradeoff
A   StreamBox Plus   $14   No ads, within $15 budget, 2 screens, broad movies+series   Not as strong for classic films as CineNest
B   FamilyFlix   $13   4 screens and kids content make it the most practical family choice   No sports focus; only 4 screens for 5 people
C   SportSphere   $19   Best for documentaries and live football in one bundle   Most expensive single service here; less broad movie/series value
Best Picks for Each Household
Option 1: Household A —   StreamBox Plus     Ad-free, 2 screens, 4K, stays under budget     $14/month
- Best fit because the couple   hate ads  , and that rules out CineNest despite its stronger classic-film library.
- StreamBox Plus gives a broader movie/series catalog and a cleaner viewing experience.
-   Tradeoff:   they give up some classic-film specialization.
Option 2: Household B —   FamilyFlix     Built for households with children and supports more simultaneous viewers     $13/month
- Best fit for a family of 5 because it has   kids content   and   4 screens  , which is the highest screen count in the set.
- It is comfortably under the $20 budget, leaving room for flexibility.
-   Tradeoff:   4 screens is still one short of 5 people all watching separately at once.
Option 3: Household C —   SportSphere     Best for live football plus documentaries in one package     $19/month
- Best match because this viewer mainly wants   documentaries   and   one football match per week  .
- SportSphere is the only option directly centered on   live sports  , and it also includes documentaries.
-   Tradeoff:   it costs nearly the full budget and is less versatile for general entertainment.
Best Alternatives and Tradeoffs
Household A: Why not CineNest?
-   CineNest ($11)   has the strongest match for   classic films  .
- But it includes   ads  , which directly conflicts with a major stated priority.
- If classic-film depth matters   more   than avoiding ads, CineNest becomes the value alternative.
Household B: Why not combine services?
- No useful combo fits the budget well for this family.
-   FamilyFlix + StreamBox Basic = $21  , already over budget.
- Since FamilyFlix alone already covers children and the highest screen need, a combo adds less value than for other households.
Household C: Why not StreamBox or CineNest?
-   StreamBox Basic/Plus   do not mention live sports, so they miss the football priority.
-   CineNest   has prestige drama and classic films, not sports.
- SportSphere is the only option that directly covers the user’s weekly sports habit.
Final Recommendation by Household
-   A — StreamBox Plus   if ad-free viewing is non-negotiable.
-   B — FamilyFlix   for the strongest family practicality.
-   C — SportSphere   for the cleanest match to documentaries + football.
Sources
- No external sources used: based only on the bundle and household data provided in your prompt.
